home.title: Risk Analysis Tool
home.introHtml: Pick a risk analysis tool to get started. Each one helps you review controls, identify gaps, and generate a clear risk summary.

reference.title: Risk Reference
reference.introHtml:
Risk is calculated from likelihood and impact factors.

  • Likelihood = avg(exploitability, exposure, prevalence)
  • Impact = avg(confidentiality, integrity, availability)
  • Risk score = ceil(likelihood × impact)
